verdict: Nothing about this deck's mana flow or card flow is what limits it; conversion is. On 120 fresh games against the standard pod on the sleeved list it took first 20 times of 99 decided (0.202, ci95 [0.135, 0.292]) against this table's null of 0.180, reached second place 35 times of 94 ranked games, and dealt 4.52 damage a game (ci95 [3.52, 5.51]) while taking 37.92 in combat alone. Twelve of those 20 wins were `effect of 'Approach of the Second Sun'`, and the group that finds Approach is three cards deep at 0.495 assembled. The difference from the previous 120-game run is NOT a decline and is not read as one here: -0.0500, Newcombe ci95 [-0.1614, +0.0644], on a pair whose minimum detectable difference is 0.185.
